description: This file initializes and renders the root React component in a web application. It imports React, ReactDOM, CSS styles, and the main App component, then renders App within a strict mode boundary into the DOM element with id 'root'.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a root for rendering a React application into a specified DOM element.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders a React element into the root container.
